notes: **Item R4 of the Results voice review: Ch. 4 + the Fig. 4 caption** (the shared fiber and starch signal on 7H). This chapter is not in the mini paper, so it is written in Evgeny's voice already; it opens with its aim. Only clarity fixes.

**¶1:** the 38-word sentence about the gene's position is split. "Identified at the level of the family rather than as a characterized ortholog" becomes "annotated at the family level, without a characterized ortholog".

**¶2 (logic):** "Because the gene lies on the minus strand, all three were located in its putative promoter region" implied that the strand put the SNPs in the promoter. The strand only explains why "upstream of the transcription start site" means higher coordinates. The sentence now states the location and puts the strand in parentheses.
**¶3:** "a single group of four SNPs" becomes "a single **marker** group of four SNPs:", the term the M&M defines.

**Fig. 4 caption** (checked against `Figure_4/Fig4.png`, which matches):
> - Title: "haplotypes of five elite malting cultivars" becomes "genotypes … at this gene", as in Fig. 3.
> - Added "red triangles, the three genome-wide significant SNPs": panel c shows them, but the caption did not say so (TAG: identify every element).
**Unchanged:** all numbers; ¶3's statistics and the cultivar sentence; "matching the negative phenotypic correlation" (you kept it on 27.9, item 1.3).
